world: a sunny little cove on a rocky seashore, turquoise shallow water and gentle white-foam waves, tide pools among mossy dark rocks, a pale sand beach with scattered shells and starfish, a weathered wooden pier and a small stone lighthouse on the cliff, sea caves glowing with soft blue light, seabirds, bright morning sky with soft clouds

b-crab.describe: a small cute beach crab about the size of a cat, glossy coral-red and sand-colored shell with tiny barnacles, two oversized pincers raised playfully, little eyes on stalks, a few bubbles at its mouth, scuttling sideways on wet sand

b-octopus.describe: a large heavy octopus clinging to a rock, deep blue-violet skin with teal spots, eight thick curling tentacles with pale suckers, big intelligent golden eyes, a cloud of dark ink swirling behind it, water dripping from its body, crafty and menacing

b-turtle.describe: a gigantic ancient sea turtle, the lord of the cove, a massive domed shell covered in coral, seaweed, barnacles and small rock pools, wise wrinkled face with deep sea-green eyes and a long white beard of kelp, enormous flippers, water cascading off its shell, a swirling wave and glowing blue water magic around it, majestic and calm
